class.name: LobbyDirectory
class.brief_description: Extend it to host, join and list lobbies of an online service.

method.name: _accepts_empty_address
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] when an empty address is valid. [code]false[/code] by default.

method.name: _address_help
method.description: Return a sentence to show under the address field, such as where to find a lobby id. Empty by default.

method.name: _address_label
method.description: Return the title of the address field, such as [code]"Lobby ID"[/code]. [code]"Lobby"[/code] by default.

method.name: _address_placeholder
method.description: Return the placeholder text of the address field. Empty by default.

method.name: _can_host_here
method.description: Return [code]false[/code] when this build can only join lobbies. [code]true[/code] by default.

method.name: _can_probe
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] when a lobby can be checked without joining it. [code]false[/code] by default.

method.name: _capabilities
method.description: Return the [enum Capability] flags this directory supports. None by default.

method.name: _client_settings
method.description: Return the fields a join form asks for, with their default values. They are passed to [method _join_lobby]. Empty by default.

method.name: _display_name
method.description: Return the name shown in a server browser. [method _peer_class] by default.

method.name: _host_lobby
method.description: Create a lobby, then call [method deliver] with the host [MultiplayerPeer], or [method fail]. [param settings] holds the fields from [method _host_settings]. [code]name[/code], [code]max_players[/code] and [code]visibility[/code], a [enum NetwServerInfo.Visibility], are common.

method.name: _host_settings
method.description: Return the fields a host form asks for, with their default values. They are passed to [method _host_lobby]. Empty by default.

method.name: _is_available
method.description: Return [code]false[/code] when the service does not work on this platform. [code]true[/code] by default.

method.name: _join_address
method.description: Return the address of the current lobby, for the host to share. Empty by default.

method.name: _join_lobby
method.description: Join the lobby at [param address], then call [method deliver] with the [MultiplayerPeer], or [method fail]. [param address] is one from [method publish_lobbies], or one a player typed.

method.name: _leave_lobby
method.description: Leave the current lobby, if any. Called when the match ends.

method.name: _list_lobbies
method.description: List the lobbies, then call [method publish_lobbies] or [method fail].

method.name: _local_member_name
method.description: Return the local player's display name. [method local_member_name_default] by default.

method.name: _member_name
method.description: Return the display name of [param peer_id]. [method member_name_default] by default.

method.name: _peer_class
method.description: Return the class name of the [MultiplayerPeer] this service uses, such as [code]&"SteamMultiplayerPeer"[/code]. Two directories in one session must return different classes.

method.name: _timeout_hint
method.description: Return how many seconds a request may take before it fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT].

method.name: deliver
method.description: Reports [param peer] as the result of the current request. Do not assign it yourself.

method.name: fail
method.description: Reports that the current request failed. [param message] is shown to the player.

method.name: local_member_name_default
method.description: The default [method _local_member_name].

method.name: member_name_default
method.description: The default [method _member_name], [code]"Player <peer_id>"[/code].

method.name: publish_lobbies
method.description: Reports the lobbies [method _list_lobbies] found. The three arrays are matched by index. Use the [member NetwServerInfo.app_id] the host sent, so lobbies of other builds show as incompatible.

method.name: supports
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [method _capabilities] includes [param capability].

signal.name: invite_received
signal.description: Emitted when the player receives an invite. Needs [constant CAPABILITY_INVITES].

signal.name: provider_unavailable
signal.description: Emitted when the service cannot be used at all.
